title: High-Protein Beef Burritos
summary: Lean minced beef cooked with diced white onion, bone broth, Taco Bell taco sauce, tomato paste and reduced-fat cream cheese until creamy, divided between eight high-protein wraps and finished with a sour-cream-and-Frank's-RedHot drizzle sauce. Louis Howard's review/recreation of a recipe credited to @Cookingforgains; he rates it 9.8/10.
serves: 8 burritos (description); narration drifts to 'gone for four' and 'coming off in pairs of two'

ingredients.note: Spoken '2 lbs extra lean meat, beef' (0:16-0:17) — 2 lb ≈ 907g corroborates the written metric amount.
Spoken 'Chop up a white onion' (0:10); mass only in the written list.
Spoken garble 'half cut bone broth' (0:17) [sic — auto-caption]; the written '½ cup (about 120ml)' is the measurement, not the garble.

ingredients.item: Taco Bell taco sauce (or salsa to taste)
ingredients.note: Spoken 'a packet of Taco Bell seasoning' (0:19) + 'taco' (0:21) and garble 'cowpiss' (0:19) [sic]. Description says 'taco sauce', narration says 'seasoning' — kept the written product; packet size/variant unstated.

ingredients.item: Reduced-fat cream cheese (or light sour cream)
ingredients.note: Spoken '1/3 fat cream cheese' (0:22) [sic — auto-caption '1/3 fat']; description says 'reduced-fat cream cheese or light sour cream'. Fat fraction unspecified; kept the written amount.

steps.text: Cook the diced white onion in a pan over medium heat until it starts to brown.
Add the mince and cook it through. Add the bone broth, turn the heat low and stir in the taco sauce (or salsa), tomato paste and cream cheese. Mix until creamy.

ingredients.note: DESCRIPTION spec. The narration instead describes 'Half a cup plain Greek yogurt' (0:38-0:39) — a different base; see notes/gaps, unresolved.
DESCRIPTION spec. Narration says 'Half tspoon hot sauce' (0:41-0:43) [sic] — different amount and unspecified brand; unresolved.

steps.text: In a bowl, mix the sour cream, Frank's, paprika, garlic powder, salt and lime juice. Add a little water until it is thin enough to drizzle.

ingredients.note: Description 'Makes 8 burritos' / '8 high-protein wraps'. Spoken 'eight wellness wraps. I've gone for four in case it tastes like' (0:50-0:54, garbled) and 'coming off in pairs of two' (1:01) — yield drift; kept the written 8. Brand/size unstated.

steps.text: Divide the beef between the eight wraps, drizzle over the sauce, fold in the sides and roll them up.

nutrition.note: Creator-reported estimate from the description: 'Estimated macros per burrito: 288 calories | 33g protein | 8.25g fat | 31g carbs. Macros will vary depending on the wraps and brands you use.' Narration corroborates: 'under 300 calories and 33 g of protein' (1:09-1:12). No legible on-screen macro card appears in any sampled frame (OCR raw + preprocessed returned noise; control-proven vision read vision/read-macros.txt confirms 'no legible macro numbers'), so all four figures rest on the description alone. Not independently calculated; the narration's divergent sauce base is not reconciled into these figures.

notes: Louis Howard's description credits @Cookingforgains ('Recipe inspired by @Cookingforgains'). This capture documents Louis's public review/recreation; the credited original was not independently audited.
Verdict: description 'Rating: 9.8/10'; spoken 'That's lovely. 10 out of 10. I'll be leaning closer to a 9.8, but still very good' (1:21-1:25).

Yield conflict: description 'Makes 8 burritos' and '8 high-protein wraps'; narration 'We're going to be using eight wellness wraps. I've gone for four in case it tastes like' (0:50-0:54, garbled) and 'These are coming off in pairs of two' (1:01). The written 8 is the spec; the spoken drift to four is recorded, not harmonized.

Sauce-base divergence (cross-surface conflict): the DESCRIPTION drizzle sauce is light sour cream + Frank's RedHot + smoked paprika + garlic powder + salt + lime juice + water. The NARRATION instead describes 'Half a cup plain Greek yogurt' (0:38-0:39), '1 tbsp of light mayo' (0:41), 'Half tspoon hot sauce' (0:41-0:43), paprika, garlic powder, 'A pinch of salt', 'A splash of lime juice' and water (0:43-0:48) — a Greek-yogurt-and-mayo base with no named Frank's. Both are preserved; which sauce was actually used is unknowable from the source. The recipe card follows the written description.

Auto-caption garbles preserved verbatim, not repaired: 'cowpiss' (0:19), 'half cut bone broth' (0:17), 'eight wellness wraps' (0:50), '1/3 fat cream cheese' (0:22), 'a packet of Taco Bell seasoning' (0:19, vs description 'taco sauce'), 'Half tspoon hot sauce' (0:41).

Marketing CTA, not recipe content: description 'Click the link in my bio, and I'll show you how to lose fat and keep it off in just 13 days!' and the spoken 13-day free-email pitch (0:26-0:36). Recorded as the creator's funnel claim; no affiliate link surface was captured.

No legible on-screen ingredient/quantity or macro cards in any sampled frame: the 24-frame base sweep plus dense filling (14-26s), sauce (36-50s) and macro/wrap (50-58s, 66-76s) windows OCR'd to noise on both raw and preprocessed passes; control-proven vision reads (vision/read-cards.txt, vision/read-macros.txt) confirm only product labels, no legible lists. The description is the sole measured spec surface.

source.quantity_basis: Measurements and estimated per-burrito macros from the public description (the sole measured spec surface).
